description: Route européenne de d'Artagnan is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département du Gers. The European Route d’Artagnan is a transnational equestrian route. Five roads cross several countries in the footsteps of the most famous Gersketeer, from Lupiac, the place of his birth, to Maastricht, the place of his death. This project is led by the French Horse Riding Federation. Coverage: Département du Gers. The portal shows the English title as "European Route of D’Artagnan" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Département du Gers. Its keywords include sports, cheval, transports-et-mobilite, mobilite-douce, circuit-touristique, equestre. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, JSON, ZIP. The listing shows 2024-07-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
